{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the premises
print('Shape:', df.shape)
print('\nFirst few rows:')
print(df.head())

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print('\nNumber of unique patient_id:', df['patient_id'].nunique())
print('Total rows:', len(df))
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', len(df) - df['patient_id'].nunique())

# Check if sample_seq > 1 exists (indicating re-test)
print('\nMax sample_seq:', df['sample_seq'].max())
print('Rows with sample_seq > 1:', df[df['sample_seq'] > 1].shape[0])

# Check arm distribution
print('\nArm distribution:')
print(df['arm'].value_counts())

# Check responded values
print('\nResponded distribution:')
print(df['responded'].value_counts())

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print('\nNumber of -999 in biomarker_baseline:', (df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999).sum())

# Check assay_batch
print('\nAssay batch distribution:')
print(df['assay_batch'].value_counts())"}
